description: Defines common response models for API responses such as error, success, pagination, and validation errors, using Pydantic for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Standard error response model with error message, details, and timestamp.

classes.name: SuccessResponse
classes.description: Standard success response model with message, data, and timestamp.

classes.name: PaginationResponse
classes.description: Model for pagination metadata including total items, current page, page size, total pages, and navigation flags.

classes.name: PaginatedResponse
classes.description: Generic response model for paginated lists, containing items and pagination info.

classes.name: ValidationErrorDetail
classes.description: Model for detailed validation error info per field.

classes.name: ValidationErrorResponse
classes.description: Model for validation error responses, including error type, message, details, and timestamp.

methods.name: ErrorResponse.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an error response instance with required fields.

methods.name: SuccessResponse.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a success response with optional data.

methods.name: PaginatedResponse.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a paginated response with items and pagination info.

methods.name: ValidationErrorDetail.__init__
methods.description: Creates a validation error detail for a specific field.

methods.name: ValidationErrorResponse.__init__
methods.description: Creates a validation error response with details list.
